# Proposal outcomes reconcile from the index: the Ruby client showed
# :proposed forever; here applied/rejected release the pin and the status
# line names the outcome.

fulcrum sync
cp edited.json skills/estimation-rubric.json

# --yes needs --note: the reviewer note is required.
fulcrum -code 2 publish --yes
grep 'needs --note' last-stderr.txt

fulcrum publish --yes --note automated
grep 'Proposal #101 submitted' last-stdout.txt
fulcrum status
grep 'proposed' last-stdout.txt

srv apply 101
fulcrum -code 1 status
grep 'proposal #101 accepted' last-stdout.txt
grep '"status": "applied"' skills/.fulcrum-sync.json

fulcrum sync --force
fulcrum status
grep 'synced' last-stdout.txt

# Rejected: the outcome is named and the local edits remain.
cp edited2.json skills/estimation-rubric.json
fulcrum publish --yes --note second-try
grep 'Proposal #102 submitted' last-stdout.txt
srv reject 102
fulcrum -code 1 status
grep 'proposal #102 declined' last-stdout.txt
cmp skills/estimation-rubric.json edited2.json

-- edited.json --
{
  "rubric_id": "org-default",
  "status": "edited-locally"
}
-- edited2.json --
{
  "rubric_id": "org-default",
  "status": "edited-again"
}
